summary: At stable superproject HEAD e80e92cbba2a557648ed7d9281ad92dcf2a16fc5 and desktop HEAD b0df06e011b13c8bfa26c75f78b0f3a21d8e17af, the focused release-journal, publisher restart/lost-response, nightly-cut, managed-spawn, artifact-trust, real-Postgres receipt, and desktop Linux/manifest recovery suites passed. The policy and exact-file TypeScript guards passed in the same stable-head batch. A later current-tree assertion-integrity run passed at c3584a09870f57b8817f44b08f3758566680e33d. These already-executed checks demonstrate reconciliation before retry, stable one-use request identities, zero duplicate provider mutations after accepted-response loss, verified-byte reuse, and fail-closed behavior for missing, surplus, corrupt, or identity-mismatched outputs.
